scope: CartPole extension; existing assignment report/data/checkpoints preserved

configuration.action_sampling: categorical via independent per-episode NumPy RNG
configuration.value_target: unnormalized GAE advantage + frozen old state value
configuration.objective: uniform-transition PPO clipped surrogate; no absolute gamma^t
configuration.actor_initialization: same Policy constructor and torch seed as REINFORCE

budget_reason: Match original no-baseline REINFORCE environment steps exactly: 1384029; original constant-baseline run has 1290047 steps and is a descriptive comparator. Equal steps do not imply equal compute.

pilot.purpose: Execution/timing check excluded from final comparison; no final-evaluation tuning

selection: Freeze final PPO at fixed step budget, no evaluation-based model selection. No learning-threshold early stopping.

fresh_evaluation.action_rule: stochastic categorical; same independent per-episode NumPy RNG protocol
fresh_evaluation.statistics: sample SD ddof=1; paired seed differences also saved

historical_comparability.note: Original 80m outcomes already seen; primary new comparison uses fresh 84m seeds.

method_differences: PPO uniform-transition clipped surrogate has no absolute gamma^t; original REINFORCE uses episode-start-discount weighting.
PPO GAE and learned state critic versus original zero or prior-batch scalar EMA baseline.
PPO bootstraps on official TimeLimit final observations; original finite-episode Monte Carlo treats it as an endpoint.
PPO uses actor LR0.0003 versus REINFORCE0.01, advantage normalization, multiple minibatch epochs and gradient clipping0.5.
Actor architecture and initialization, raw observations, action space, environment cap, gamma and CPU match.
limits: One training seed; descriptive algorithm/configuration comparison, no isolated causal claim about clipping or time weights.

pilot_measured.note: Short timing/execution run only; episodes vary in length and full runtime may differ. A start-policy metadata label was corrected after this pilot; no algorithm hyperparameters changed.
